description: DONE (folded 2026-07-03 as 0f280c004, two-lane audited PASS/PASS). The consult ledger (transport_closure_consult_dependents) was a monotone-growing dense cross-product never pruned; now consult edges track LIVE membership in lockstep with the closure cover. SolvedTransportClosure gains consulted:HashSet (the only per-closure ownership record); insert/remove_transport_closure_consult_edges fire alongside record/drop_solved_transport_closure. clear_solved_transport_closures drains+returns (#[must_use]); invalidate_transport_products walks the intact pre-clear ledger THEN prunes — the drain-walk ORDERING is the crux, mutation-verified: moving the prune before the walk FAILS the .28.5 contract test (proving the hazard real AND that the .28.5 regression test guards reintroduction). Kept dense (disjoint-membership invariant airtight: record_solved_transport_closure drops every prior closure sharing any member first, so removal is exact); sparse rejected (would under-invalidate co-members = the .28.5 bug). 2 new tests, mutation-verified non-vacuous. Both .28.5 contract tests green. Single-shot unaffected (no re-solve, nothing prunes). Fold-nit applied: commit message softened (matrix set is the pre-existing thread-count-sensitive ~19, not a hard 21; the 420/380 ledger figures rest on #[cfg(test)]-only instrumentation). NOTE for incremental-session followup: a shipped telemetry field for ledger edge count (vs #[cfg(test)]-only) would let the bounded-growth property be observed in production per 'tests observe telemetry'.
title: Prune the transport consult ledger on closure re-solve (monotone dense over-invalidation)
